meta.title: Textile rental and end-to-end textile management | VELUM
meta.description: Rental, laundering and complete management of your textiles across Spain. A single point of contact, full traceability and the assurance that everything is under control.

hero.sub: We manage the full lifecycle of your textiles —supply, laundering, replenishment and traceability— so you can focus on what truly matters: your guests.

trust.line: Nationwide coverage for hospitality, food service and healthcare. A single point of contact, from Cádiz to Girona.

manifesto.title: We are not a laundry.
manifesto.bodyHtml: We don't sell laundering. We sell the certainty that every sheet, every tablecloth and every coat will be exactly where it needs to be, flawless, when you need it. We are the team that looks after your textiles from start to finish —no surprises, no emergency calls, no excuses— so your brand can be felt in every touch. You're not buying laundering. You're buying peace of mind.

items.title: Traceability and inventory control

sustainability.title: Caring for your textiles also means caring for the world around us.
sustainability.body: Professional textile management is, by nature, more sustainable than washing at home or in small machines: we extend the working life of every item and make the most of every resource. We do it because it's the right thing to do and because your brand is measured by it too.
claims: Lower water and energy use per kilo compared with conventional washing, thanks to industrial scale.
Circular economy: we repair and reuse textiles before retiring them, and recycle them responsibly at the end of their life.
Textile traceability that reduces losses and extends working life.

coverage.title: All of Spain, to one single standard.
coverage.body: We operate across mainland Spain with two of our own plants and a network of approved partners working to our protocols. Whether you have one establishment or a hundred, the service is the same everywhere.

items.q: What is textile rental and how does it work?
items.a: It's the rental of bed linen, table linen and other textiles with laundering, maintenance and replenishment included for a recurring fee. You don't buy textiles or tie up capital: you pay per use and we take care of everything else.

items.q: What are the advantages of outsourcing a hotel's or restaurant's laundry?
items.a: You eliminate investment in machinery and staff, turn a fixed cost into a variable one based on occupancy, free up space and secure constant quality and availability. Your team focuses on the guest, not on the textiles.

items.q: How much does the service cost?
items.a: It depends on volume, type of item, occupancy and frequency. That's why we always start with a free textile assessment: we analyse your operation and present a tailored proposal, with no obligation.

items.q: Is rental more sustainable than buying and washing?
items.a: Yes. The professional management model extends the working life of every item, optimises water and energy at industrial scale and reduces textile waste through repair, reuse and responsible recycling.

items.q: Do you comply with hygiene regulations for healthcare textiles?
items.a: We work to standard UNE-EN 14065 (biocontamination control, RABC) and to ISO quality standards, with documented traceability. The hygiene of healthcare textiles is an absolute, documented priority.
We provide coverage across Spain with our own plants and a network of approved partners, and soon in Portugal. Wherever you are, the standard of service is the same.

items.q: How do you manage replenishment and textile losses?
items.a: We control your inventory and replenish according to your occupancy, minimising losses: you always know what you have and where it is.
